tools.name: ipqualityscore_check_ip
tools.description: Score an IP address for fraud risk: proxy, VPN, Tor, bot, recent abuse, and the fraud_score (0-100). Use it on sign-ups, logins and payments. Each call uses IPQualityScore credits. API: GET /api/json/ip/{key}/{ip}.

tools.name: ipqualityscore_check_email
tools.description: Validate an email address: deliverability (valid, disposable, catch-all, suggested fix for typos), MX/SPF/DMARC, leaked or honeypot status, and fraud_score. Use it before sending mail or creating an account. API: GET /api/json/email/{key}/{email}.

tools.name: ipqualityscore_check_phone
tools.description: Validate a phone number: validity, line type (mobile, VoIP, prepaid, toll-free), carrier, country, active status, risky and recent-abuse flags, and fraud_score. Give the number with its country code. API: GET /api/json/phone/{key}/{phone}.

tools.name: ipqualityscore_check_url
tools.description: Scan a URL for malware, phishing and spam: unsafe flag, domain age, category, redirects, final URL, adult content and risk_score. Use it before showing a user a link. API: GET /api/json/url/{key}/{url}.

tools.name: ipqualityscore_get_credits
tools.description: Read the account's remaining credits and this billing period's usage per product (ip, email, phone, url, mobile SDK). Call it to see how many lookups are left. API: GET /api/json/account/{key}.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ipqualityscore_check_email, ipqualityscore_check_url, ipqualityscore_get_credits · Public sink: ipqualityscore_check_email, ipqualityscore_get_credits.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ipqualityscore_check_email, ipqualityscore_check_url, ipqualityscore_get_credits · Public sink: ipqualityscore_check_email, ipqualityscore_get_credits

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
